page.overview:
Who is Dorthey?

Dorthey is a minor character who appeared in Street Fighter II V who only appears in Episode 2.

Dorthey is a staff member of the Air Force stationed in San Francisco. Ken comes across her looking for Guile. She directs him to the gym, but Ken seems smitten offers her a drink. He then spots picture of Guile holding a trophy, according to Dorthey, he was transfers to San Francisco sometime ago and won a tournament which surprised the whole base. She ask Ken if he knows him, he states that he is his student, much to her disbelief. Dorthey later watches Ken and Guile's match which Ken was defeated. She send flowers to him with a note saying Take care. Category:Characters Category:Street Fighter II V Characters Category:Non Video Game Characters Category:Female Characters
